correctness.rationale: Exact complex-coordinate algebra checks the Koras--Palka parametrized four-cuspidal quintic P(u)=(u^4,u^2-u^5,1+2u^3). Independent symbolic P cross P-prime factors u(u^3+2)(4u^3-1,2u^2,-u^4); after base-factor removal the dual map satisfies (B^2-4AC)^2+128 B C^3=0. The rational inverse u=-(B^2-4AC)/(8BC) on BC nonzero, singleton exceptional fibers and Jacobian equation imply a unibranch cusp at [1:0:0], Puiseux (2,7) type A6, and no other singularities. Wronskian -4u^3(u^3+2)^2 has zeros only at original four cusps (including homogeneous infinity check), so no smooth flex. The statements hold, but mathematics was known before this submission.

originality.rationale: FAIL: This exact four-cuspidal quintic and its projective dual as a single-A6-cusp quartic with three flexes were explicitly described in T. K. Moe, Rational Cuspidal Curves, arXiv:1511.02691 (2015), section 6.3 C8 pp.91–93. Moe displays the same parameterization [s^4t:s^2t^3-s^5:t^5+2s^3t^2], states the quintic is dual to an A6-cuspidal quartic, provides the quartic equation y^4-2xy^2z+x^2z^2-yz^3=0 (projectively equivalent to submitted polynomial), and records no inflection points on quintic. The unicuspidal quartic duality also forces no distinct-branch bitangents, since such lines would be extra singular points of the dual; the claimed tangent properties are direct consequences. The candidate omitted this decisive earlier primary work. This is not merely matching title/parameter: same explicit parametrization, duality, cusp stratum and inflection facts. No PASS permissible.
residual_risks: No scientific proof gap identified in candidate, but correctness does not imply originality.
Earlier thesis already contains the full duality, explicit equations and inflection data; there is no surviving independently valuable remainder by coordinate rewriting.
